capabilities: Focus one to three current tasks on a whiteboard
Triage tasks through a workbench inbox, to-do list, and cache list
Organize tasks into kanban-style task pools
Store tasks as Markdown files with frontmatter and export/import Canvas format
Archive, complete, delete, and link tasks to notes without moving them
disambiguation: Not a simple todo list; it is a four-layer workspace with a whiteboard, workbench, expandable task pools, and long-term objects.
extras: The AI buttons are interface placeholders only; the plugin sends nothing to network services. An interactive browser demo and a demo video exist outside this README, and the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A one-time 0.1.11 migration rewrites managed frontmatter and needs Sync coordination across devices.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in structure for juggling immediate versus long-term tasks, so work at different attention levels sits unorganized in plain notes.

relations.evidence: Before the first 0.1.11 startup, let Obsidian Sync finish and disable or update older plugin builds

summary: Layered task workspace that manages focused tasks on a whiteboard, a workbench, kanban-style task pools, and long-term objects, stored as Markdown and Canvas files.
